description: The equipment system manages gear items worn by the player across 10 body slots. Equipment provides base attributes, random attributes, and participates in suit set bonuses. Sub-systems include refinement (per-slot level ups), advancement (stage-based group upgrades), and resonance (milestone rewards). Equipment is primarily obtained from treasure box opening with a pity/guarantee system. The visual figure system overlays equipment appearances on the character model for slots 1-5.

equipment_slots.description: Equipment is worn in up to 10 body part slots, identified by the 'part' field in ConfigEquipment and 'location' in the player's equip_list. The first 5 slots (weapon, ornaments, face, fate, wing) have visual figure overlays on the character model. The remaining 5 are stat-only.

1.name: Weapon
1.description: Primary weapon slot. Determines the weapon model displayed on the character. Can be overridden by artifact_figure.

2.name: Ornaments
2.description: Ornamental headgear/accessories. Visible on the character model. If in appearance_head_not_face list, hides the face slot.

3.name: Face
3.description: Face decoration/mask. Visible on the character model. Hidden if ornaments are in the appearance_head_not_face list.

4.name: Shoulder Guard (Hujian)
4.description: Shoulder/fate slot. Has visual figure mapping. Forced to 0 in Team20, WorldBoss, and DoubleLadder battle modes.

5.name: Armor (Kaijia)
5.description: Armor/wing slot. Has visual figure mapping for wing display.

6.name: Arm Guard (Bijia)
6.description: Arm guard slot. Stats only, no visual figure.

7.name: Gloves (Shoutao)
7.description: Gloves slot. Stats only, no visual figure.

8.name: Belt (Yaodai)
8.description: Belt slot. Stats only, no visual figure.

9.name: Leggings (Hutui)
9.description: Leg armor slot. Stats only, no visual figure.

10.name: Shoes (Xiezi)
10.description: Footwear slot. Stats only, no visual figure.

equipment_slots.note: Slot IDs are defined by ConfigEquipment.part and used as location values in equip_list. Visual figure slot definitions at line 187440.

key_fields.name: Equipment name (string_ref)
key_fields.suitId: Suit set ID (0 = no suit; references ConfigEquipment_suit)
key_fields.atlas: Atlas resource ID for icon lookup
key_fields.wearable: Job type that can wear this equipment (0 = all classes; matches ConfigJobs.type)
key_fields.is_precious: 1 if the item requires confirmation before selling
key_fields.unlock_level: Player level required to use this equipment
key_fields.is_hide: Hidden from normal UI lists (0 or 1)

quality_tiers.description: Equipment quality tiers determine color, rarity, and stat ranges. Shared quality system used by equipment, gems, and other items.

base_attributes.description: Each equipment has base_attr (up to 4 base stats) stored as [{k: attr_id, v: value}, ...]. These are the primary stats like HP, ATK, DEF, etc.
base_attributes.display_order: Sorted by the attrToIndex mapping at line 280036

random_attributes.description: Each equipment can have up to 2 random attributes (rand_attr). These are percentage-based bonus effects displayed as percentages (value / 10000 * 100).
random_attributes.code_reference: for (var v = t.rand_attr || [], _ = 0; _ < 2; _++) { ... txtValue.string = d.formatStr('%s%', 100 * r / 1e4) }

equipment_attr_config.description: Defines attribute groups for equipment random attributes. The group_id links to ConfigEquipment.advanced field. When opening treasure boxes, attributes are randomly rolled from the group.

fields.value: Value range array for the attribute

equip_attr_display_list.description: The ordered list of attribute IDs displayed in equipment detail views

attr_value_display_rules.description: Attribute values display differently based on ConfigAttribute.show_type

rules.show_type_3: Display as Math.floor(value) / 10000 (decimal fraction, e.g., 0.5 for 5000)

equipment_level.description: Defines the level-up costs and basic stat multiplier per equipment slot and level.

fields.basic: Basic stat multiplier at this level
fields.price: Cost to enhance to this level, format: [[item_id, amount], ...]

equipment_level_weights.description: Global config defining level drop probability weights when generating equipment from boxes
equipment_level_weights.interpretation: Offset from base level with probability weight (e.g., 0 offset = 6000 weight = most common)

suit_system.description: Equipment suits grant bonuses when multiple pieces from the same set are worn. Each suit has threshold bonuses at different piece counts.

fields.num: Number of pieces required to activate this bonus tier
fields.effect: Array of effects granted by this tier
fields.name: Name of the bonus tier (localized string)

counting_logic.code: getEquipWearCountBySuitId: for each equipped item, if configEquipment.getDataByKey(equip.config_id).suitId == target_suit_id, count += 1
counting_logic.display: Shows as 'BonusName (currentCount/requiredCount): description' with color #FDF9B8 if active, #908474 if inactive

refinement_system.description: Equipment refinement is a per-slot leveling system. Each of the 10 equipment slots has its own refinement level. Refinement adds percentage-based multipliers to the equipment's base attributes. The slot with the lowest refinement level is automatically selected for upgrade.

fields.attar: Array of attribute multipliers at this level, format: [[attr_id, multiplier_value], ...]. The multiplier is applied as base_attr_value * multiplier / 10000.
fields.cost: Cost to refine, format: [[item_id, amount], ...]. Last entry with empty cost array marks the max level.

refinement_formula.description: Refinement bonus for each base attribute is calculated as a percentage of the equipment's base stat value, using the refinement level's multiplier.

variables.i: base_attr value (the equipment's base attribute value for matching attr_id)
variables.d[1]: refinement multiplier from ConfigEquipment_refinement.attar entry matching the attr_id

refinement_formula.example: If weapon has base HP=5000, and refinement level 10 has attar [[1002, 5000]], then refined HP bonus = Math.round(5000 * 5000 / 10000) = 2500

slot_selection.description: The UI auto-selects the equipment type with the lowest refinement level
slot_selection.code: (-1 == s || s > o.v) && (s = o.v, t.curSelEquip = n)

refine_slot_types.description: All 10 equipment types participate in refinement

display.logic: For each of the equipment's 4 base_attr entries, find matching attr_id in refinement.attar, apply multiplier, display as flat value or percentage depending on show_type

operations.single_refine: equip.equip_refine_c2s with type=1 - refines one level for the lowest-level slot
operations.batch_refine: equip.equip_refine_c2s with type=2 - refines multiple slots at once

advancement_system.description: Equipment advancement is a stage-based system that applies to ALL equipment slots collectively. When all 10 slots reach the refinement limit for the current stage, the player can advance to the next stage, unlocking higher refinement limits and granting global attribute bonuses.

fields.attr: Array of global attribute bonuses at this stage, format: [[attr_id, value], ...]
fields.cost: Cost to advance to this stage, format: [[item_id, amount], ...]
fields.limit: Maximum refinement level allowed at this advancement stage (0 = unlimited/final stage)
fields.power: Combat power value for this stage

advancement_attr_display.description: Attribute IDs commonly displayed in the advancement detail panel

advancement_trigger.condition: All 10 slot refinement levels must equal advancement.limit (all slots maxed for current stage)
advancement_trigger.code: var p = r == s && s == a.limit; // r = max level across slots, s = min level across slots, a = current advancement config
advancement_trigger.explanation: When max(all_levels) == min(all_levels) == limit, advancement is available

max_limit_calculation.description: The absolute max refinement level is determined by the highest limit across all advancement stages

stage_up_logic.response: Updates the stage value in refineInfo

resonance_system.description: Equipment resonance is a milestone reward system tied to advancement stages. When the player reaches a certain advancement stage, they can claim resonance rewards that grant permanent attribute bonuses.

fields.attr: Array of cumulative attribute bonuses from this resonance level, format: [[attr_id, value], ...]
fields.current_attr: The specific attribute bonus at this resonance level (displayed individually)
fields.stage: Required advancement stage to unlock this resonance
fields.power: Combat power value for this resonance

red_point.logic: Red point appears when any unclaimed resonance milestone has stage <= current advancement stage

guarantee_system.description: Pity/guarantee system for equipment box opening. After a certain number of opens without a high-quality drop, the system guarantees one.

fields.num: Number of opens trigger threshold (pity counter)
fields.part: Optional restriction on which equipment parts are guaranteed

treasure_box_system.description: Equipment is obtained by opening treasure boxes using a consumable item (box_goods_id). The box has its own leveling system that improves drop quality over time.

auto_open.description: Auto-open feature that continuously opens boxes and auto-sells equipment below quality/attribute thresholds
auto_open.interpretation: [box_level, batch_size] - at box level X, can auto-open Y at a time

auto_open_conditions.description: Players configure auto-sell conditions with quality threshold and attribute filters
auto_open_conditions.logic: Equipment is kept if quality >= threshold AND either filter slot matches (both required attrs present in rand_attr). If both filter slots are disabled, all equipment passes.

stat_contribution_flow.description: Equipment stats flow into the player's total attributes through the following pipeline

steps.name: Base Attributes
steps.description: Equipment's base_attr values (up to 4) are added directly to player stats

steps.name: Random Attributes
steps.description: Equipment's rand_attr values (up to 2) provide percentage-based bonuses

steps.name: Refinement Bonus
steps.description: For each base_attr, refinement multiplier is applied: bonus = round(base_value * refinement_attar / 10000)

steps.name: Advancement Bonus
steps.description: Global attribute bonuses from current advancement stage are added

steps.name: Resonance Bonus
steps.description: Cumulative attribute bonuses from all claimed resonance milestones are added

steps.name: Suit Set Bonus
steps.description: If enough pieces from the same suit are equipped, set bonus effects are applied

player_attribute_flow.note: getRoleAttrById aggregates all attribute sources on the server side; the client simply reads the final values

equipment_comparison.description: The checkIsBetterEquip function compares a candidate equipment against the currently worn one in the same slot.
equipment_comparison.logic: For each base_attr in the worn equipment, check if the candidate's matching attr value is >= the worn value. If ALL worn attrs are <= candidate attrs and at least one is strictly less, the candidate is better.
equipment_comparison.auto_replace: Better equipment triggers a notification via OPEN_EQUIP_EDITOR_VIEW event

figure_system.description: Equipment figure/appearance system. The setPlayerEquip function reads equip_list from the player figure data and maps slot keys to visual model components.

visual_mapping.k=4: fate figure (default=0, forced to 0 in Team20/WorldBoss/DoubleLadder)

skin_override_rules: If artifact_figure > 0, weapon figure (slot 1) is replaced with artifact figure
Hair figure (hair_figure) sets the color value for character tinting
If a dress skin has only_skin=1, all visual slots + mount are cleared to 0
If only_skin=2, only weapon is cleared to 0
If only_skin=3, ornaments and face are cleared to 0
If ornaments ID is in appearance_head_not_face list, face is forced to 0

figure_customization.description: Players can customize which equipment appearance shows per slot via EquipFigureView. The locationToFigure map stores per-slot overrides: 0 = show equipped item, -1 = hide slot, >0 = show specific config_id.
figure_customization.function: getEquipFigureByLocation(location) returns the figure override for a slot

equipment_tabs.description: Players can save multiple equipment loadouts (tabs/presets). Each tab has its own set of equipped items.
equipment_tabs.tab_limit_source: ConfigGlobal.equip_tab_limit defines the number of available tabs

event_list.EQUIP_FILTER: Fired when equipment filter settings change
